integrity: Complete self-contained proof and deterministic bounded numerical checker; numerical finite cases are not infinite proof.
scientific_limitations: Only nonzero integer lattice Fourier modes, equally weighted simplex digits and scalar integer base are covered. Older equivalent extremal results may exist, and direct full-text comparison to the 2012 and 2015 spectrality publications was unavailable; independent mathematical validation has not been performed.
title: Sharp lattice Fourier contraction for simplex self-similar measures
